rationale: Y reads as an architect's drawing set: a dimensioned elevation with numbered callouts and a title block, mono labels, and a serif/italic terracotta headline accent. It has a coherent rust, cream and green palette and a tighter hero with a metrics row visible at the fold. X is clean but conventional, with a heavy five-line display headline, a flat cartoon house illustration, an even card grid and a standard SaaS section rhythm, so it is the more template-like of the two.
